title: Bounded-Defect Proper Orientations and Graphs on Surfaces
summary: Chen, Mohar and Wu [J. Combin. Theory Ser. B 161 (2023)] conjectured that every graph of orientable genus $g$ has proper orientation number $O(\sqrt g)$. We prove this conjecture. Our main result extends the potential-outdegree method from independent color classes to three parts of bounded internal degree. Let $k,D\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$.
